summary: Independent EvidenceGate review approves TASK-0044. The fix is scoped to timeout recovery and audit correctness, not Mode C promotion. TASK-0043 remains completed as a no-go package; isolated timeout handling now prefers durable child-run state over synthetic skipped results, finalizes a running GoalExecution whose active PlanExecution is terminal failed through GoalOperationService semantics, reconstructs Planner status from preserved artifacts, preserves no-state runner_timeout fallback, and keeps unavailable provider token/cost usage null. Focused tests, lint, AWKP lint, diff check, manifest/digest audit, and full tests passed.

criteria.criterion: TASK-0043 remains completed as a no-go evidence package and Mode C remains non-default.
criteria.notes: TASK-0043 is completed at state_version 4 with an approved no-go EvidenceGate report; TASK-0044 report explicitly states this does not promote Mode C.

criteria.criterion: Timeout recovery prefers durable child-run evidence over synthetic skipped results when a timed-out isolated child wrote a request and SQLite store.
criteria.notes: scripts/run_real_agent_pilot.py TimeoutExpired path calls RealAgentPilotRunner.recover_timeout_run; recovery checks goal-run-request.yaml and .ahra/goal-control.sqlite3 before falling back.

criteria.criterion: A GoalExecution left running with an active terminal failed PlanExecution is finalized to failed through the normal service path.
criteria.notes: GoalOperationService.finish_active_plan_if_terminal uses PlanExecutionService.finish_active_plan_execution, and tests assert a running GoalExecution with failed active PlanExecution becomes failed.

criteria.criterion: Recovered timeout run-result includes actual `goalExecutionId`, `planExecutionId`, `goalStatus`, `planStatus`, metrics and failure_class.
criteria.notes: Regression test asserts recovered run-result includes goalExecutionId, planExecutionId, failed goal/plan statuses, metrics, and timeout failure_class.

criteria.criterion: Planner status is reconstructed from preserved Planner/admission artifacts when wrapper stdout/stderr is unavailable.
criteria.notes: _planner_from_artifacts reconstructs accepted/rejected/blocked Planner state from preserved admission/output/blocker artifacts; regression test asserts accepted Planner reconstruction.

criteria.criterion: If no durable state exists, the existing `runner_timeout` blocked behavior is preserved.
criteria.notes: Regression test confirms no durable request/SQLite state preserves the existing blocked runner_timeout synthetic behavior.

criteria.criterion: Provider token/cost unavailable fields remain null, not fabricated.
criteria.notes: Provider usage path is unchanged; existing tests and report confirm unavailable token/cost fields remain null rather than fabricated.

criteria.criterion: Regression tests cover recovered timeout state and no-state timeout fallback.
criteria.notes: Focused tests cover recovered timeout state, script timeout hook routing, service-level finalization, and no-state fallback.
